integrity: Self-contained analytic proof of matching small-eigenvalue power bounds up to a logarithmic factor, with an exact bounded consistency check.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite dimensions N>=3, iid Haar-uniform nodes, consecutive frequencies. The mean inverse-Gram threshold is exact; for the statistical interpretation the noise has conditional second moment nu times the identity. Logarithmic sharpness and dimension-uniform constants are not claimed. Priority remains provisional; full Bass–Gröchenig original was not inspected.
title: The exact inverse-moment threshold for independently sampled Fourier frames
